summary: Sandbach United fell to a 1-0 defeat against New Mills in their season opener at Hind Heath Road, despite creating several chances throughout the match. The Blues had chances through Cain, Hatton, and Saul but couldn't find the back of the net, while New Mills capitalised on a scrambled goal midway through the first half. It was a frustrating start to the campaign for Bach, who will be looking to bounce back in their next fixture.
